note: QNTM CTRL, The Eagle and the Senses EP (Oblivious Transfer, OBTRAN001, November 2021). Paul, 25 October: Random Value over the destruction of Lyra, Endless Expansion (high paced, spaceship travelling music) through space, The Eagle and the Senses on the new planet into the tribal celebration. Loops cut on the beat by tools/make_music.py --comic obtran001 (bpm: the loop's tempo; each loop starts on a beat and holds whole bars, so the drum can lock to it). Full tracks (file) still to come.
